sync.q: How do I synchronize my data?
sync.a: Synchronization happens automatically when you are online. Check the status indicator at the bottom of your screen.

storage.a: Your data is stored securely on your computer first (LocalBridge) and then copied to our encrypted cloud servers.

devices.a: Yes, you can install Djati on multiple devices. Data will sync across all of them automatically.

articles.inventoryContent: 'Automatic Order' displays all products nearing stock-out. You can quickly create an order from your suppliers.
articles.securityContent: The Master user can view all stores and reports. The Worker user is limited to their store and to sales only.
